Title: Tanay's Day

Cast

1. Tanay - 8 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Sunita - 41 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The garden - flower beds, a mango tree
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The garden - Day

[Tanay stands in the garden. Sunita stands near him.]

Tanay: "What lovely weather!"

[Tanay waters the plants.]

Sunita (surprised): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Tanay chases a butterfly in the garden.]

Tanay (softly): "Careful!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Sunita: "So, here we are!"

[Tanay dances to the music.]

Sunita: "Good job, Tanay!"

[Tanay sings a song.]

Tanay: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Tanay hugs Mother tightly.]

Sunita: "Tanay, are you okay?"

[Tanay shakes his head.]

Tanay: "Mom, listen!"

[Tanay scratches his head.]

Sunita: "This is amazing!"

[Tanay thinks for a moment.]

Tanay: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Tanay whispers something to Mother.]

Tanay: "What a day to remember!"
